mapper.sql: id, skill_id, name, description, content, category, tags, status, submitter, approver, approve_comment, submitted_at, approved_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_draft (skill_id, name, description, content, category, tags, status, submitter) VALUES (#{skillId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{content}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{status}, #{submitter})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_draft WHERE skill_id = #{skillId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_draft SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, tags = #{tags}, status = 'PENDING', submitted_at = NOW(), approver = NULL, approve_comment = NULL, approved_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM skill_draft WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND skill_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT skill_id FROM skill_publish WHERE status = 'APPROVED') ORDER BY submitted_at DESC
